discovery.title: NASA is due to share an update on its next Moon missions
discovery.summary: NASA scheduled an October 23 briefing on Artemis plans, including upcoming missions and lunar lander preparations.
discovery.why_it_matters: The details could affect mission timelines, commercial partners and when astronauts return to the Moon.
